# Medvind til containershipping trods store udfordringer

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode (EuroInvestor) about container shipping and world trade, with guests Lars Svendsen (Svendsen & Tidbo) and Peter Sand (Xeneta). Freight rates rose sharply after the US-Iran war and are expected to peak on US routes and ease, while forwarders such as DSV have been squeezed on price. Lars Svendsen took profits in tanker stocks (Torm, NAT, International Seaways, Frontline), still holds Maersk and expects a Q3 upgrade, but says he expects a big bump ahead geopolitically.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars keeps his position and expects a positive Q3 upgrade like Hapag-Lloyd's. He sold half his A-shares at 21,000.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Svendsen sees book equity of about 25,000/share as likely undervalued, plus terminal and network value. Hapag-Lloyd's upgrade points to a strong Q3 for Maersk. He took partial profits, warns of a geopolitical 'big bump' ahead, and Xeneta expects US rates to peak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no Q3 upgrade
- if freight rates fall sharply
- if China-West trade tensions escalate

> *"jeg sidder og venter på, at der kommer en opregulering af, at der kommer sådan en profit warning til den gode side"*

---

### 🔴 TRMD — Torm | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Lars sold yesterday after a strong rise and is satisfied.

#### Reasoning

Guest took profits on tanker strength after a large price run, rotating within tankers.

> *"Jeg solgte et torm i går, men fordi den var jo helt op"*

---

### 🔴 NAT — Nordic American Tankers | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Sold as one of the weakest supertanker names.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen exited the weaker supertanker names after the tanker rally.

> *"jeg har taget de dårlige, eller de svageste af supertankerne, og det var Nat"*

---

### 🔴 INSW — International Seaways | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Sold together with NAT as a weaker supertanker name.

#### Reasoning

Profit-taking and rotation away from weaker tanker names.

> *"og det var Nat, og det var International Seaways"*

---

### 🔴 FRO — Frontline | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Sold 60% at about NOK 520 after a NOK 32 dividend. Keeps a small stake for the AGM.

#### Reasoning

Price plus dividend gave a large gain, so Lars trimmed most of the position while keeping a token stake.

> *"så har jeg taget 60% af Amher frontfidusen ud"*

---

### 🟡 PBR — Petrobras | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars holds a large position, rising on hopes of an election win for Bolsonaro the younger. He is considering when to sell.

#### Reasoning

Brazilian stocks are rallying on the election outlook and high oil prices. The guest has not sold yet but is thinking about timing.

#### Sell Triggers

- election outcome
- oil price falls

> *"Jeg har jo en hel del Petrobras. Aktierne i Brasilien stiger."*

---

### 🟠 GMAB — Genmab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Good phase 3 data, stock up 7%. Lars would only buy if it falls to about 1500.

#### Reasoning

Lars says he does not understand the biotech and only buys on deep dips. He sold earlier at 2100. The host holds it and is positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- failed trial data

> *"nu sidder jeg og venter på, at den er kommet ned i 1500"*

---

### 🟠 DSV — DSV | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Forwarders are being squeezed on price by carriers in a rising short-term freight market.

#### Reasoning

Peter Sand (Xeneta) explains that forwarders on quarterly contracts have paid the price for rising spot rates, which pressures margins. Easing rates could relieve this.

> *"De presser dem på prisen."*

---
